Description:
Covers the steps of a mass spectrometry based label-free
quantification (LFQ) analysis: quality control, normalization,
aggregation of peptides to proteins, modelling, hypothesis
testing and sample size estimation. A single function,
build_contrast_analysis(), fits a model per protein and
computes contrasts with one of many methods: linear, robust and
rank-based regression, 'limma' and 'limma'-voom, 'DEqMS'
variance moderation, the detection probability model of
'limpa', Firth logistic and binomial models of detection, mixed
models and ROPECA on peptide-level data, a hurdle model
combining intensity and detection, and variants that impute
groups without observations at the limit of detection. All
methods return their results through the same interface and
columns, so they can be compared and combined. Models simple
designs with one explanatory variable as well as experiments
with several factors. Developed while analysing dozens of
proteomics datasets at the Functional Genomics Center Zurich.
